text_block_list.text:
"Today marks the end of summer training camp.
Just as we're about to board the bus back to the academy—"

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Please, somehow!!
Just a single comment!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
We apologize, but please understand.
They are exhausted after their training.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha... What a handful, Tazuna-san.
The media's goal is obviously—

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
There you are!! Narita Brian-san!
Will you be running in the Kikuka Sho this autumn?!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text: "Could you please give us a word on your enthusiasm! Anything will do!!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: ...Tsk.

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
So after that, will you be facing your sister, Biwa Hayahide,
at the Arima Kinen?!
To see the first-ever showdown between sisters—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: —Heh.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: A race against Sis, huh...!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
...! Brian-san!
What was that look just now—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Time's up! That's all, folks!
Please, everyone, no more questions!!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: Brian-chan just smiled, didn't she?
choice_data_list: Ah, when I heard the name Biwa Hayahide...

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Hayahide-chan...
If I recall, she showed some powerful running
in this year's Tenno Sho (Spring) as well.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Stacking up consecutive wins, and just like Brian-chan,
being called the "strongest currently active"...!

—Biwa Hayahide. I owe a lot to her
from before the Japanese Derby.

I recalled her calm and collected demeanor,
yet brimming with fighting spirit against her younger sister, Narita Brian.
choice_data_list: I wonder which one will win...!
I wonder which one will win...!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
I know the feeling!
Just hearing about a showdown between
the ultimate sisters gets me so excited!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text:
Trainer,
when the time comes, let's go watch too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Laurel
text_block_list.text: I want to burn Brian-chan's run for the title of strongest directly into my memory!

And so, wrapped in sheer fervor,
the summer training camp came to a close.
